summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress of its share buyback program announced on October 30, 2025. From June 22-26, 2026, it repurchased 72,733 shares at an average price of €5.91 per share for total consideration of €430,128. Since program start on January 26, 2026, the company has bought back 1,070,597 shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for €5,210,264 under an authorized €30 million mandate. Repurchases occur on NASDAQ through an independent intermediary. The program reduces share count and signals management's view of undervaluation. Watch for continued execution pace and potential earnings impact.
